title: The Effects of MiFID II on Voluntary Disclosure
authors: Chongho Kim; Jihwon Park; Edward Sul
eligible_reason: MiFID II unbundling: post = 1 if cyear > 2017 for all firms; treat = EU (non-U.S.) firms vs U.S. controls. Single common adoption date (January 2018), not staggered. Every column also includes time-varying firm controls ($ctrlvar).
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe). Replication_Code.do line 149 (Table 3): reghdfe {i_guide, n_guide} c.post##c.treat $ctrlvar, absorb(gvkey cqtr) cluster(gvkey); ctrlvar = log_mve_new roa btm lev bad intan_ratio n_ann_analyst_lag instown std_ret _48. Tables 5-7, 9: triple interactions with analyst-coverage loss, accuracy, size, volatility, guidance increase. Figure: i.treat##i.cqtr. Quarterly 2013Q1-2019Q4.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: MiFID II effective January 3, 2018 for all EU firms.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common adoption date; time-varying controls
specs.controls: log_mve_new roa btm lev bad intan_ratio n_ann_analyst_lag instown std_ret _48
specs.sample_condition: firms observed pre and post; U.S. exchanges 11/13/14

data_files_note: Intermediate analysis files built from WRDS (Compustat NA/Global, Capital IQ, IBES, CRSP, 13F, Datastream, FactSet) are shipped.
software_notes: Stata 18 (reghdfe) plus SAS 9.4 for data construction.
